instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: linear games are better than open worlds.

The Last of Us is mostly linear, and that is why every scene hits so hard. Resident Evil 4 throws a new idea at you every hour because it never has to fill an empty map. Even Final Fantasy XIII's hallways told a tighter story than most open maps. Agree?
